verification_contract: Only canonical crates.io registry identity may match this allowlist.
Each added companion must have the exact name, version, source and required parent package/version/source/direct dependency string.
Every other added identity or changed source is a failure retained for manual review.
Before/after ten lock hashes, all package and edge deltas, and source pins must be reported.
No candidate Cargo.lock is committed automatically; Linux and macOS checks follow separate lock review.
The two AutoEQ exact wasm-bindgen manifest pins and gpui-toolkit minicov 0.3.8 forced target must be separately observed in final locks, even if not highest compatible versions.
